parameters.content:
## 1. Invoice comes in
By email (subject contains *invoice*, PDF attached) or the test upload form.

## 2. AI reads the PDF
Gemini extracts vendor, PO number, line items and totals into fixed fields. The AI only *reads* - it never decides.

## 3. Rules decide
Compare with the PO sheet: vendor, items, quantity, price, total, duplicates. Also checks the AI's reading with the invoice's own maths.

## 4. Act
Every invoice is logged. Only mismatches go to a human on Slack.
